name: locked
meaning: 1 = no detection (no targets, or msg 0x4D arg 1 which also shows the pressed anim)

name: type
meaning: PROPERTY_SENSIBLEBUTTON_TYPE: 10/14 ground-snap ignoring objects, 12 starts hidden and disabled, 14 makes msg 2 answer 0 instead of 0x27, so the button does not attract sheep; data uses 0, 1, 12

name: pressBox
meaning: model box 0; translated to pos for the occupancy grid query

name: homePos
meaning: pos after the Init ground snap; restored by Reset (unless a Train exists) and msg 0x1000

name: occupants
meaning: objects on the plate this frame (zeroed each Update); passed as arg of MSG_SWITCH_ON

name: clickSound
meaning: channel of sfx 0x36 (press and release click)

name: targets
meaning: objects from the TARGET id list

name: targets2
meaning: objects from the TARGET2 id list

name: targetCount
meaning: entries in targets (Scn_FindIdList count; not clamped to 8)
